	<div class='heading'>
	<h1>Deity Class Entities <a name='Nirrum's Encyclopedia of Varomar 2:Lore:Deity Class Entities'></a></h1>
	</div>

	<div class='content'>
	<p>
Created Saturday 30 March 2024<br>
MANAR / ENGLISH trans / KONIAN / DANZUISHANESE / DRACONIC / FEY / OCEANIC  / GRAO / LELUMADIL / KARA'ITEAN / TURTLE / GIANT / 
</p>

<br>

<p>
Rathpet Kwatsi'ta Olopinra / Sunlight feeds the world / KONIAN NAME / DANZUISHANESE NAME / <br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
-sun and agriculture god, very pro-civilization, distinctly not the actual sun, but something that channels sunlight<br>
- Blesses the grass road more than any other reegion. 
</div>
Wilderness overcomes all boundaries<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
-Wilderness god, almost the devil but not quite
</div>
Water becomes blood<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
- Life giving water god, slightly less pro-civilization
</div>
Sky-Scouring Wind<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
- A storm god who constantly has to fight for their place. Rather typical of storm gods
</div>
Breeze like Medicine<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
- A goblinoid wind and weather god who steals their power from the storm god
</div>
Knowledge builds itself<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
- a god of knowledge, script, and transferred intention
</div>
Rainguide<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
- a civilization god, increasingly powerful, Increasingly Artificial
</div>
Beauty from hand and tool<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
- a Craft god, a beauty god, beloved by the dwarves and dragonkin
</div>
Divided, the shadow spreads<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
- a death god, an entropy god, from whom many colours and much inspiration flow. <br>
- Constantly at odds with the duality of caring for life while also being one of the forces that ends it
</div>
Instinct for Control<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
- A draconic deity, perhaps the source of all native dragons<br>
- An adversarial force for the  world
</div>
Hate for itself<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
- A war god, deeply at odds over the source of its power
</div>
Magic descends from heaven<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
- A magic god that was forced to leave the world
</div>
Howling from deep shadows<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
- A force of chaos that revels in destruction
</div>
Dreams lead the mind<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
- A fey deity that straddles worlds and despises stagnation
</div>
Silence beyond the grave<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
-An Undead deity that really does not like other things moving<br>
-A massive bully among deities<br>
-Demonic, arguably
</div>
Star-swallowing Jaws<br>
<div style='padding-left: 30pt'>
-A Draconic protector who considers all things to be their treasure
</div>
</p>

<br>
<br>

<p>
Skal Welch, The Volcano Reborn<br>
The Runner<br>
The Erdshaka<br>
Moon-eyed Child<br>
Exi
</p>
